notes: Canon-tracking power curve for all of Book 1. Only tiers 0 and 1 are reachable in Milestone 1. Stats are absolute values for the tier, not deltas. 'unlocks' lists card types or mechanics that open at this tier.

tiers.name: Starving Mortal
tiers.canon: Gangly with hunger, 'could count a good number of my ribs.' One bow, three arrows, one knife.

tiers.name: Fed Huntress
tiers.canon: Venison on the table for the first time in weeks. A small mercy, but she is steadier for it.

tiers.name: Guest of the Spring Court
tiers.canon: Fed, bathed and rested at the manor; given freedom of the grounds.

tiers.name: Suriel Hunter
tiers.canon: Traps the Suriel and survives the naga, with Tamlin's help.

tiers.name: Fire Night
tiers.canon: Calanmai. Confidence, defiance, and the first encounter with Rhysand.

tiers.name: Prisoner Under the Mountain
tiers.canon: Beaten, starved and caged. A deliberate dip: power drops when canon says it should.

tiers.name: Trial Survivor
tiers.canon: Outwits the Middengard worm and survives the second trial, bound by Rhysand's bargain.

tiers.name: Made Fae
tiers.canon: Remade by the seven High Lords. Immortal strength, speed and senses. The gap from Tier 0 should be obvious.
